subject: Close cadence: velocity plan + stall response for SyncWare
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Emily Zhang <emily.z@syncware.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Updated MAP + target close check-in

Emily —

Following our demo earlier this week, I attached an updated mutual action plan (MAP_v2.pdf) with a tightened evaluation cadence and recommended checkpoints. Current target close is 2027-05-28 but I want to confirm that still works for procurement and security on your side.

High-level asks from SyncWare to keep that date:
- SOC 2 evidence + security Q completed by 5/19 (we supplied the questionnaire today)
- Procurement to confirm SOW terms by 5/24
- Two-week pilot start on 5/20 (can be shortened to 1 week for quicker sign)

Can you confirm blockers and whether those dates are realistic? If you see a risk to 5/28, tell me which is the single biggest blocker and we'll triage.

Attachments: MAP_v2.pdf

Thanks,
Aditya
Senior Sales Engineer
Redwood Inference
--
Aditya Rao | aditya_rao@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182

From: Emily Zhang <emily.z@syncware.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: SyncWare Procurement <procurement@syncware.com>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Updated MAP + target close check-in

Aditya —

Thanks for the MAP and the call. Quick status: procurement has flagged two items that will delay approval in the current cadence: (1) our legal team needs an explicit clause for data separation during the pilot, and (2) finance needs a clarified billing milestone schedule. Also, our InfoSec asked for SOC 2 Type II evidence (not just questionnaire answers) before sign-off on the pilot.

Practical impact: procurement now expects to sign by 2027-06-03, not 5/28. InfoSec says they can provisionally approve a pilot with an isolated environment only if Redwood provides a short security pack and an SRE contact for the first week of onboarding.

I'll escalate internally but wanted to be transparent. I can aim for an exec review on 5/20 to try to move things earlier.

Regards,
Emily Zhang
Head of Platform Partnerships, SyncWare
emily.z@syncware.com
--

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 12:10:00 -07:00
Subject: SyncWare — procurement stall (risk log + proposed rebaseline)

Team —

Emily replied that procurement and InfoSec are the immediate blockers and procurement now expects to push to 2027-06-03. Attached the security pack they requested (security-pack.zip) and the MAP_v2.pdf I sent. I recommend we treat this as a Level 2 close-risk and propose a controlled rebaseline with mitigation actions.

Summary risk log (quick):
- Risk ID: R-SYNC-001
  Impact: Close slip to 2027-06-03 if InfoSec requires SOC2 Type II evidence.
  Likelihood: Medium (procurement + legal flagged clauses).
  Mitigation: Provide condensed SOC-related artifacts, designate SRE onboarding lead, and offer a short liability-limited pilot contract to procurement.

- Risk ID: R-SYNC-002
  Impact: Pilot delayed or shortened -> evaluation inconclusive.
  Likelihood: Medium-Low.
  Mitigation: Offer one-week rapid pilot option with prescriptive test plan and hands-on support.

Proposed rebaseline (one-line):
- New target close: 2027-06-03 (contingent on delivery of security artifacts by 5/19 and SOW sign by 5/27).

Action items (owner / due):
- Share curated SOC evidence + short security pack (Aditya) — due 2027-05-15 (completed, attached).
- Draft limited-scope SOW that addresses procurement clauses (Marissa) — due 2027-05-17.
- Assign SRE onboarding lead and calendar a live runbook session (Rishi/Monica) — due 2027-05-18.
- Sales to offer a 2-week trial credit package to reduce procurement friction (Marissa/Aditya) — decision due 2027-05-16.

I suggest we escalate to Marissa for an executive sync if procurement holds to 6/3. If we can commit SRE support and a limited liability SOW quickly, Emily indicated procurement may move faster.

Attaching: MAP_v2.pdf, security-pack.zip

Thanks,
Aditya

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SyncWare — procurement stall (risk log + proposed rebaseline)

Thanks for the quick triage, Aditya. Good assessment.

I am scheduling an exec sync with Emily for 5/20 at 10:00AM PT to clear legal questions — I will lead the SOW redline discussion. To accelerate procurement, we will:
- Produce a limited-liability SOW (first draft attached as SOW-draft.docx) that includes the requested data separation clause and milestone billing.
- Offer SyncWare a $15k pilot credit and SRE on-call for the first week of pilot onboarding (Rishi/Monica to define scope).
- Prepare an internal one-pager for execs summarizing risk and upside (Marissa) for 5/20.

Please confirm owners: Rishi — take point on SRE staffing and runbook. Monica — prep the onboarding checklist and the short playbook for the pilot. Aditya — share the security artifacts with Emily and follow up after the exec sync.

I'll update the HubSpot deal record and create a Jira ticket for the SRE runbook work (PLT-2142).

-Marissa
Director, Sales Ops
Redwood Inference
--

From: Emily Zhang <emily.z@syncware.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 14:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Close cadence: velocity plan + stall response for SyncWare

Marissa / Aditya —

Appreciate the fast turnaround and the SOW draft. The exec sync on 5/20 is helpful — I'll bring legal and procurement. Two notes post-review: (1) procurement indicated they can sign a limited-liability SOW if we add explicit pilot success criteria and a 30-day billing hold clause; (2) InfoSec confirmed they will accept the condensed security pack for a provisional pilot if we provide an SRE contact and calendar the onboarding runbook session before the pilot starts.

Target from our side now: procurement approvals by 2027-05-27 and final sign by 2027-05-31 (their internal target). If everything goes as discussed, we can keep the pilot start around 2027-06-01 and still be able to evaluate in time for a commercial close by 2027-06-03.

Please send the Docusign link for the SOW after 5/20 and we'll route through procurement. Also attaching a short internal procurement checklist for your reference.

Best,
Emily
--
Attachments: procurement-checklist.xlsx
